name: Sabrina Osbourne
source:
Sabrina is a classic goth girl, rebelling against any authority figure she can. She has a fascination with the occult, perhaps due to the strange items she helps sell at Hex-Rated. Although she puts up a tough front, there's more to her than meets the eye at first glance.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
